title: Uno: A One-Stop Solution for Inter- and Intra-Data Center Congestion Control and Reliable Connectivity
problem: Cloud/AI workloads generate heterogeneous traffic (intra-DC and inter-DC) with different RTT characteristics. Existing congestion control treats them separately, causing rate unfairness and slow loss recovery. Need unified solution.
motivation: Coexistence of intra and inter-DC traffic with RTT disparity complicates congestion management. Individual control loops are suboptimal. Faster intra-DC responses cause unfairness when competing with slower inter-DC flows.
method: Uno treats all network traffic—whether within a data center or between distant ones—with a single unified system. It uses a transport protocol that quickly detects congestion and fairly adjusts each application's send rate to avoid starvation. It also spreads traffic across multiple paths using erasure coding (splitting data into redundant pieces so you can recover the original from fewer than all pieces) and adaptive routing that continuously selects the best path based on real-time network conditions.
key_novelty: A single unified congestion control system handles both intra- and inter-datacenter traffic fairly despite different round-trip times, using integrated erasure coding and adaptive routing.
contributions: Unified congestion control system for intra and inter-DC traffic
Transport protocol with rapid response and fair rate control
Load balancing combining erasure coding and adaptive routing

metrics.fairness: Fair rate allocation across RTT disparity

limitations: Abstract only; no specific performance numbers; traffic patterns not detailed; scalability analysis missing; reliability guarantees not quantified.
